# AI Crawler Rules
> robots.txt checker and generator for 20 AI and search crawler tokens, sourced from operator docs (2026-11-20).

- Checker: https://basileion.github.io/ai-crawlers/
- Guide: https://basileion.github.io/ai-crawlers/guides/block-ai-training-keep-ai-search/
